title: Finance data migration may exceed the cutover window
description: The second migration rehearsal produced 41 reconciliation exceptions against a tolerance of 10. Thirty-one trace to cost centres retired in the 2024 restructure and never mapped in the migration ruleset. If the third rehearsal does not clear them the 52-hour cutover freeze is not long enough to resolve them in flight.
impact: Milestone M2 slips and the first finance close on the new system moves by one period.
mitigation: Mapping fix written and awaiting a third rehearsal on the weekend of 2026-09-05. Fallback is to accept a two-day slip and cut over on 2026-09-18.

title: Second integration vendor has not confirmed the test window
description: Three written requests since 2026-07-22 have gone unanswered. Without a confirmed window the payments interface cannot be regression tested before the M2 freeze.
impact: Cutover proceeds with the legacy payments bridge in place for the first two weeks after go-live, carrying manual reconciliation effort.
mitigation: Contractual escalation to the vendor account director under decision SC-2026-08-03, five working day response deadline.

title: Forecast overrun exceeds delegated tolerance
description: Forecast at completion of 515000 USD against an approved 480000 USD is an overrun of 7.3 per cent, above the 5 per cent delegated tolerance of the programme.
impact: A change request to the investment board is required before further spend is committed.
mitigation: Change request for 40000 USD in preparation under decision SC-2026-08-02, due 2026-09-15.

title: Hypercare staffing is not confirmed
description: No hypercare rota exists for the six weeks following the M2 cutover, and two of the four named finance specialists have leave booked in that window.
impact: First-line response targets during hypercare are missed in the first two weeks after go-live.
mitigation: Hypercare staffing plan to be brought to the September steering committee.

title: Warehouse test environment availability
description: The shared warehouse test environment was unavailable for eleven days in July following a failed storage upgrade.
impact: Warehouse integration testing is delayed and M3 float is consumed.
mitigation: Environment rebuilt on dedicated storage on 2026-08-08 and stable since.

title: Training room availability
description: Regional training rooms were double booked for two of the four cohorts.
impact: Training cohorts slip and user readiness at cutover is reduced.
mitigation: All four cohorts completed by 2026-08-25 with 94 per cent attendance.

title: Legacy payments bridge is retained beyond two weeks
description: If the payments interface is not regression tested before go-live the bridge may need to remain in place beyond the planned two weeks, which requires a licence extension.
impact: Unbudgeted licence cost of approximately 6000 USD per month.
mitigation: Licence extension priced and held ready; decision point is 2026-09-25.

title: Cost centre mapping fix introduces new defects
description: The mapping fix written for R-1 touches the shared journal import path used by both the finance and warehouse modules.
impact: A regression in the warehouse module appears after the M2 cutover, affecting a workstream that is currently green.
mitigation: Regression suite for the shared import path extended on 2026-08-28; full run scheduled with the third rehearsal.
